notes: Now remembers your window size, scan folders and thresholds.
patch_notes:
Your window size, scan folders, thresholds and toggles are now remembered between runs, saved in ~/DiskCleaner/settings.json and restored on the next launch. Settings are saved when a scan starts and when the app closes, so a crash or a self-update does not lose them; a missing or damaged settings file falls back to the defaults.
Fixed: the Biggest folders tab's Open button opened the folder's parent instead of the folder itself; it now opens the folder.
Also fixed the built-in checks for the Biggest folders tab, which still expected the older design and failed against the app as shipped in v1.2.8.
